a.motion: The child lifts the single red apple slightly above the fruit bowl and smiles; retain one apple in the hand.

abu.motion: Abu turns one book page while the friend watches and smiles; keep both original characters and their clothing.

am.motion: The boy makes a small friendly self-introduction gesture and nods; keep the teacher and classroom unchanged.

amber.motion: Amber makes a small paintbrush stroke over the existing sunflower painting; keep the composition and colors unchanged.

an.motion: The child brings the single apple close for a tiny bite and lowers it; preserve the original apple and character.

ant.motion: The ant's antennae sweep and its six legs make a tiny walking motion along the same leaf.

apple.motion: Only the green leaf and short stem sway gently on the red apple; the apple body stays in place and keeps its shape.

are.motion: The two children give small friendly nods while looking at their shared open map; keep the map and people unchanged.

bag.motion: The cloth shopping bag's handles sway and its fabric creases softly; keep the bag resting on the same surface.

bat.motion: The hanging bat slowly opens and closes its wings while remaining attached to the cave ceiling; keep the cave unchanged.

black.motion: The black pen on the desk rolls a tiny distance and settles; retain the black color and stationary books.

blue.motion: The blue bag's loose strap sways gently beneath the stationary wooden chair; keep the bag blue.

book.motion: The book's front cover opens slightly, a page lifts, then settles; preserve the same book and its cover color.

box.motion: The child lifts one cardboard box flap slightly and looks inside, then lets it settle; retain the same toys.

boy.motion: The boy makes a small greeting gesture toward his teacher and smiles; keep the same classroom and people.

cat.motion: The cat blinks once and gently curls the tip of its tail; keep its seated body and markings unchanged.

color.motion: The child points gently along the existing rainbow while nearby leaves sway; keep every rainbow band unchanged.

cup.motion: The cup gently rocks by a few degrees and settles; keep its handle, blue color and empty interior unchanged.

dog.motion: The sitting puppy blinks, makes a tiny head tilt and wags its tail; preserve its golden coat and seated paws.

duck.motion: The white duck gently bobs its head and lifts one foot slightly, then settles; keep the same duck.

edison.motion: Edison carefully adjusts one wooden block on the existing bridge; retain the same blocks and structure.

egg.motion: The intact egg gently rocks on its base and settles; do not crack it or create a chick.

eight.motion: The child stretches both arms after waking and relaxes them again; keep the bedroom and clock unchanged.

elephant.motion: The elephant softly waves its trunk and flaps its ears; keep all four feet grounded.

eraser.motion: The pink eraser gently tips onto one edge and settles back; do not add a face or limbs.

fan.motion: The fan blades turn through successive positions inside the stationary protective cage; keep the base still.

fish.motion: The goldfish fans its fins and gently sweeps its tail as if swimming in place.

five.motion: The teacher moves the pointing hand between the five displayed objects while the class watches; preserve the same five objects.

four.motion: The teacher makes a small welcoming hand gesture and the four children gently raise their hands; exactly four pupils.

fox.motion: The fox blinks and gently swishes its fluffy tail, with a tiny ear twitch; keep its original coat markings.

ghost.motion: The friendly paper ghost decoration gently swings from its string; keep its cute face and classroom setting unchanged.

girl.motion: The girl makes a small confident singing or speaking gesture with her hands while the seated audience remains still.

goat.motion: The small goat blinks and gently twitches its ears and tail while standing in place.

green.motion: The green leaves of the same tree sway gently; keep the trunk and the green palette unchanged.

hand.motion: The raised hand waves gently at the wrist; retain the same child and all five fingers.

hat.motion: The hat ribbon's loose end flutters gently in a breeze; keep the straw hat itself in place.

how old.motion: The parent opens one hand slightly in a questioning gesture while the child tilts their head; preserve the thought bubble without new text.

i.motion: The child points gently toward their own chest while the two children keep reading the same book.

ink.motion: The child makes a short careful motion with the ink pen above the existing writing; preserve existing marks and ink bottle.

insect.motion: The butterfly slowly opens and closes its patterned wings on the same flower.

is.motion: The boy tilts his head and makes a small pointing gesture toward himself, then rests; keep the classroom fixed.

it.motion: The boy makes a small pointing gesture toward the red ball while the ball gently rocks in place.

jam.motion: The child gently spreads the existing red jam on the same toast using the knife; keep the food and jar unchanged.

jet.motion: The jet's control surfaces move subtly and a faint existing vapor trail drifts; keep the plane centered without camera motion.

key.motion: The child's fingers turn the key a little in the same door lock and return; keep the door and lock unchanged.

kite.motion: The colorful kite tilts slightly in the same sky as its ribbon tail ripples; keep its panels and colors unchanged.

leg.motion: The seated girl gently extends the illustrated leg and relaxes it again; keep both children and the garden fixed.

lion.motion: The seated lion blinks slowly and flicks the tail tip; preserve its mane and seated body.

marker.motion: The hand makes a short coloring motion around the existing apple illustration without changing the other drawings.

mia.motion: Mia gently pets the rabbit with one hand while its ears twitch; keep both original subjects.

milk.motion: The surface of the milk makes a very small natural ripple in the glass; keep the glass, bottle and milk quantity unchanged.

monkey.motion: The monkey gently tilts the banana in its hand and swishes its curled tail; keep its seated body.

my.motion: The boy points gently at his own backpack, then relaxes his hand; preserve the original backpack and setting.

name.motion: The girl moves her pencil slightly while writing her name; preserve all existing marks without generating new text.

neck.motion: The child gently turns the head while the pointing finger continues to indicate the neck; preserve natural anatomy.

nine.motion: The nine flowers sway slightly in a soft breeze; preserve exactly nine flowers and the same arrangement.

nose.motion: The child gently touches and rubs the nose once, then relaxes the hand; keep the scarf and winter setting.

one.motion: The child gently turns the single open book page, eyes following it; preserve one book.

otter.motion: The otter floats on its back and softly paddles its forepaws, making gentle ripples.

ox.motion: The ox chews slowly and flicks one ear and its tail; keep the same horns, body and farm background.

pen.motion: The fountain pen's nib traces a tiny motion above the paper without adding marks; the detached blue cap stays fixed.

pencil.motion: The pencil rolls a few degrees on the same surface and settles; retain its original length and orientation.

pig.motion: The pink pig blinks and gently wiggles its snout, ears and curled tail; keep all four feet in place.

pink.motion: The girl makes a small turn so the pink skirt hem sways, then returns to the original pose; keep the dress pink.

pumpkin.motion: The pumpkin's green leaf and curled stem sway gently in a breeze; keep the pumpkin whole without carving a face.

queen.motion: The friendly queen slowly waves one hand from the balcony; retain the crown, costume and people below.

quiz.motion: The child makes a short pencil motion on the quiz page while the teacher makes a small encouraging nod; keep all written marks unchanged.

rabbit.motion: The rabbit wiggles its nose and gently twitches both ears while remaining seated.

red.motion: The child adjusts the red backpack strap and turns the head slightly with a small smile; keep the bag red.

rocky.motion: Rocky takes one tiny step along the path and lets the backpack straps move naturally; keep his original outfit.

ruler.motion: One end of the wooden ruler lifts slightly and settles back onto the surface; keep every graduation mark unchanged.

seven.motion: The teacher points softly toward the clock while the children look up; keep the clock face and seven-o'clock time unchanged.

six.motion: The six ducks gently paddle, making small water ripples; preserve exactly six ducks.

snake.motion: The snake makes a small smooth wave along its body and flicks its tongue; preserve its length and markings.

spider.motion: The small spider moves a few legs and lowers a little on the same web thread; keep its eight legs and the same web.

sun.motion: The painted sun's short rays softly shimmer in place; keep the disk and the warm yellow color unchanged, with no face.

teddy.motion: Teddy gently lifts the existing sandwich toward the open lunch box and smiles; retain the same lunch items.

ten.motion: The child makes a short writing motion with the pencil and looks at the page; keep all existing marks unchanged.

that.motion: The child gently extends the pointing arm toward the distant classroom object and relaxes it again.

this.motion: The child points softly at the nearby page in the open book; preserve the existing book pictures.

three.motion: The girl adjusts the three pencils in the open bag and smiles; preserve exactly three pencils.

tiger.motion: The tiger blinks and gently sweeps its tail, with a tiny head turn; preserve every stripe and all four grounded feet.

turtle.motion: The turtle slowly lifts one front foot and tilts its head; keep the shell pattern and body proportions.

two.motion: The two birds turn their heads toward each other and ruffle their wings slightly; exactly two birds remain on the branch.

umbrella.motion: The yellow umbrella's canopy trembles slightly while the existing raindrops fall; preserve its shape and handle.

up.motion: The child slowly tilts their head upward toward the moon and points a little higher; keep the night sky and moon fixed.

vampire.motion: The friendly costumed child gently lifts and lowers the cape edges while smiling at the other child; keep the scene playful and non-scary.

van.motion: The van's side door slides a little and a child makes a small greeting wave; keep the vehicle parked and the same group of children.

vest.motion: The boy gently adjusts the edges of the blue vest and smiles; keep the original outfit unchanged.

watch.motion: The boy points gently to the wristwatch and looks down at it; preserve both watch faces and their existing markings.

what.motion: The girl raises her open hand slightly in a questioning gesture toward the teacher, then relaxes it.

white.motion: The white dove makes a small graceful wing flap; keep the bird white against the same sky.

window.motion: Only the leaves outside the window sway gently; keep all window-frame panes and the interior unchanged.

witch.motion: The friendly witch's cape and hat tip flutter while the cat blinks on the same broom; preserve the moon and the original characters.

year.motion: The child gently straightens to show their height beside the wall chart; preserve the chart markings and adult's position.

yellow.motion: The yellow balloon gently sways on its string, deforming very slightly with the breeze; keep its yellow color.

yo-yo.motion: The yo-yo moves a small distance down and up along its string as the child adjusts the wrist; retain the same toy and person.

yogurt.motion: The child stirs the yogurt once with the spoon; preserve the bowl, strawberries and the original amount of yogurt.

you.motion: The girl makes a small inviting gesture toward the boy's page as the boy follows with his eyes.

your.motion: The boy gently points toward the other person's open book; keep the books and classroom unchanged.

zebra.motion: The zebra twitches its ears and swishes its tail with a small head turn; preserve its stripe pattern.

zoo.motion: One existing elephant gently waves its trunk as the children lean forward a little at the safe viewing rail; keep all subjects and barriers.
